summary_1line: Taraka’s tyranny leads gods to send Manmatha to awaken Shiva’s love for Parvati; Manmatha is burned, Parvati begins severe penance, and gods urge Shiva to marry.

image_candidates.scene_text: Shiva opens his blazing third eye and a burst of fire reduces Manmatha to ashes in the flowering Bilva garden.
Parvati stands unmoving amid five blazing fires during her severe penance in the forest while her maids watch from afar.
Rati collapses in grief before Shiva after learning that the flames of his third eye have burned her husband Manmatha.
